summary: PlatinumGames and Shinji Mikami's high-speed third-person shooter, later brought to PC and remastered on PS4/Xbox One.

entries.title: Vanquish

emulation.notes: Use the PC version natively rather than emulating seventh-generation releases.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at highest stable settings

primary.why: Vanquish released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2010, Windows in 2017, and as part of the Bayonetta & Vanquish 10th Anniversary Bundle on PS4/Xbox One in 2020. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route, while the PS4 Pro/Xbox One X remasters support 4K/60fps.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version at the highest stable settings; use the PS4/Xbox One remaster on enhanced hardware as a strong console alternative.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with configurable fidelity.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most flexible route.

all_releases.fidelity: 10th Anniversary remaster with 4K/60fps support on PlayStation 4 Pro.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong remaster route but no sourced content advantage over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Later PC and remaster versions include the practical high-fidelity route; no sourced platform-exclusive content requires a secondary playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2020 console remaster is bundled with Bayonetta in the retail 10th Anniversary package, but Vanquish can also be purchased digitally on its own.
